# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository instructions defined in `AGENTS.md`.

When working on a file, also follow any more specific `AGENTS.md` files found in parent directories of that file.

Rule precedence:

1. Root `AGENTS.md`
2. Intermediate directory `AGENTS.md` files
3. Nearest `AGENTS.md` to the edited file

More specific instructions override broader instructions.

Do not duplicate long-form rules here. Treat `AGENTS.md` as the source of truth.
